caption: The drawing features three large heart shapes outlined in red at the center and lower left and right portions of the composition, each containing cursive black German text. The background is filled with decorative floral motifs and leafy vines in shades of green, red, yellow, orange, and blue. At the upper left and right corners, there are two red and brown birds perched on vines. Various flowers with yellow, orange, and blue petals, and large red fruit-like shapes dotted with black, are interspersed throughout the image. Each heart is framed with a scalloped border, and the main, central heart is the largest. At the bottom center, behind the main heart, there is a small tree with green and yellow leaves. The entire drawing is bordered by a thin pencil or ink line, giving it a framed appearance against the light tan or off-white paper background.
title: Fraktur
